legend: A lot of frogs want to cross a river. A river is w$$$w$$$ units width, but frogs can only jump l$$$l$$$ units long, where l<w$$$l  \lt  w$$$. Frogs can also jump on lengths shorter than l$$$l$$$. but can't jump longer. Hopefully, there are some stones in the river to help them.

The stones are located at integer distances from the banks. There are ai$$$a_i$$$ stones at the distance of i$$$i$$$ units from the bank the frogs are currently at. Each stone can only be used once by one frog, after that it drowns in the water.
What is the maximum number of frogs that can cross the river, given that then can only jump on the stones?
input: The first line contains two integers w$$$w$$$ and l$$$l$$$ (1≤l<w≤105$$$1 \le l  \lt  w \le 10^5$$$) — the width of the river and the maximum length of a frog's jump.

The second line contains w−1$$$w - 1$$$ integers a1,a2,…,aw−1$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{w-1}$$$ (0≤ai≤104$$$0 \le a_i \le 10^4$$$), where ai$$$a_i$$$ is the number of stones at the distance i$$$i$$$ from the bank the frogs are currently at.
output: Print a single integer — the maximum number of frogs that can cross the river.
note: In the first sample two frogs can use the different stones at the distance 5$$$5$$$, and one frog can use the stones at the distances 3$$$3$$$ and then 8$$$8$$$.

In the second sample although there are two stones at the distance 5$$$5$$$, that does not help. The three paths are: 0→3→6→9→10$$$0 \to 3 \to 6 \to 9 \to 10$$$, 0→2→5→8→10$$$0 \to 2 \to 5 \to 8 \to 10$$$, 0→1→4→7→10$$$0 \to 1 \to 4 \to 7 \to 10$$$.

legend.ai: 有许多青蛙想要渡过一条河。河流的宽度为 w$$$w$$$ 个单位，但青蛙每次最多能跳 l$$$l$$$ 个单位，且 l<w$$$l  \lt  w$$$。青蛙也可以跳跃短于 l$$$l$$$ 的距离，但不能跳得更远。希望河中有一些石头可以帮助它们。
石头位于距离河岸整数个单位的位置。在距离青蛙当前所在河岸 i$$$i$$$ 个单位处有 ai$$$a_i$$$ 块石头。每块石头只能被一只青蛙使用一次，之后便会沉入水中。
在青蛙只能跳到石头上的情况下，最多有多少只青蛙可以渡过这条河？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 w$$$w$$$ 和 l$$$l$$$(1≤l<w≤105$$$1 \le l  \lt  w \le 10^5$$$)，分别表示河流的宽度和青蛙能够跳跃的最大长度。
第二行包含 w−1$$$w - 1$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,aw−1$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{w-1}$$$(0≤ai≤104$$$0 \le a_i \le 10^4$$$)，其中 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示距离青蛙当前所在河岸 i$$$i$$$ 的位置上的石头数量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即能够渡过河流的青蛙的最大数量。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，两只青蛙可以分别使用距离 5$$$5$$$ 处的不同石头，另一只青蛙可以依次使用距离 3$$$3$$$ 和 8$$$8$$$ 处的石头。
